title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Ramp reaches $60B valuation as it pushes deeper into AI
summary: The funding comes as Ramp's annualized revenue crosses $2B, and its customer count reaches 85,000.

title: Nasdaq-listed Tron sets up $200M ATM share offering to fuel TRX acquisitions
summary: The Nasdaq-listed treasury company holds about $237 million in TRX tokens and plans to raise additional capital to fund its purchases, alongside its daily accumulation.

title: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
summary: The HEX token’s price declined by 30% following local media reports of the Istanbul arrest of founder Richard Schueler, nearly two years after Interpol issued a “Red Notice.”

title: Bitget, Liquid exploits push Q3 crypto hacks toward $1.2B
summary: Compromised suppliers, developer tools and infrastructure components outside security audits drove about 77% of the quarter’s total losses, according to Hacken.

title: Ambani’s Jio seeks to raise $3.2B in what could be India’s biggest IPO
summary: Jio plans to use most of its IPO proceeds to repay debt as it expands beyond telecom.

title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
summary: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
summary: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.
